title: Format date and time
description: Gets the current time, adds or subtracts time, converts the time zone or formats a date-time as text. Runs inside Weav and calls nothing outside.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: now, add, subtract, format or convert.

value.title: Date and time
value.description: ISO-8601 date-time (2026-10-05T09:00:00+07:00) or date (2026-10-05), or epoch milliseconds. Required except for now.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: add and subtract: whole number from -100000 to 100000.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: add and subtract: minutes, hours, days, weeks, months or years.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: format: Java DateTimeFormatter pattern such as dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm, at most 64 characters.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone name such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. When empty, a value that carries an offset keeps it; a date, a date-time without offset or epoch milliseconds use UTC.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: vi (default) or en, for month and day names.
